descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-16 Prior Encounter Transcripts · S02 Hospital: a new day's recording archives yesterday's automatically (no manual step), and today's lines survive a reload

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U1 Each encounter's transcript is saved automatically, with no manual step. After 2+ visits, the earlier visit's transcript is there for reference without re-dictating. (UAT TC-16; TFA-92594 How it works 1; TFA-92594 AC 2)
  • U3 Entries display collapsed, each with a line count, and the line count is accurate. (UAT TC-16; TFA-92594 AC 3; TFA-92594 How it works 3)
  • U5 The expanded transcript is correctly attributed: each line shows the right speaker (Physician / Patient), and the transcript sits under the right patient and visit. (UAT TC-16)
  • T2 Collapsed rows are labelled accurately (e.g. 'Most Recent'), so each row says which encounter it is. (TFA-92594 AC 3; TFA-92594 How it works 3)
  • U11 Nothing invented or doubled: the list holds only lines that were recorded or dictated, with no added line (e.g. 'Encounter completed.') and no line listed twice. (UAT 3.4)

Test design technique: Happy path (happy-path) — Walk the normal flow exactly as the UAT / ticket words it; everything it names has to show up.

Given Tim's chromium tests: a patient whose stored transcript (2 lines) is dated a past day; a second patient with a fresh chart. Mocked speech recognizer and mocked model actions

When Record one line at the bedside on the new day and stop; then press Generate Note & Finish. Separately, record a physician line and a patient line (toggle the speaker) and reload

Then Yesterday's 2 lines move to 'Sep 24 (prior)' with speaker and time kept, and today's line is the only 'Most Recent' line. Generate does not archive again. After reload, both lines are still there, labelled Physician and Patient

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Playwright assertions: rounding.get history toEqual [{label 'Sep 24 (prior)', entries yesterday}] and transcript = today's line only (U1, U11: archived once, not overwritten, not doubled); row counts '2 lines' / '1 lines' (U3); label '(prior)' with the recording's date (T2; the 'Most Recent' assertion before recording is not T2 evidence, Q5); …

Where it ran: local lane A (existing Playwright tests); test method PW · Playwright script; lane planned in the matrix: existing tests (Tim's Playwright) (automated)

S02 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-16.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Triage (2026-10-14): 1 row.

Issue type: Test issue · environment local · tickets TFA-92594 ready for qa

The archive itself works. Since Tim's 10-12 change the transcript is hidden while recording and one Stop generates the note, so the old specs cannot find the line during the recording.

Evidence: Allure 38f69cb1, test out of date (local). 7f3907f hides the transcript while recording (EncounterTab.tsx:60-63) and auto-generates on Stop (:84). encounter-workflow.spec.ts:12 and prior-transcripts.spec.ts:161 fail. The lane notes that these two changes are visible to physicians and should be confirmed with Tim / Daniela.

Environment: local — main e02167f, local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane A.

Test method: PW · Playwright script — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: matrix (lane A).

UAT item: TC-16 Prior Encounter Transcripts · Section: A3 · Encounter · Scenario: TC-16/S02

Tickets: TFA-92594 Prior Encounter Transcripts (ready for qa)

  • encounter-workflow.spec.ts:12, prior-transcripts.spec.ts:161: Tim's 7f3907f (10-12) hides the transcript while recording (EncounterTab.tsx:60-63) and generates the note on a single Stop (EncounterTab.tsx:84); the test still looks for the line during the recording. These are two changes a physician sees; to confirm with Tim / Daniela.

Bisected on an isolated stack over 7f3907f^, 5d83248^ and 5d83248: 5d83248 brought no regression.

Existing specs:

  • encounter-workflow.spec.ts [chromium] — bedside recording persists physician and patient transcript lines after reload — unexpected
  • prior-transcripts.spec.ts [chromium] — a new day's bedside recording archives yesterday's transcript instead of overwriting it — unexpected

Failure screenshots and page snapshots are on the failing steps. Videos stay in matrix/TC-16-artifacts/ (not attached).
